usedFor: ZenCommerce holds store orders, and Freshsales Classic updates the deal with “Update Deal” once “Order Status Paid” runs.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Status Paid” in ZenCommerce, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A paid order is proof of progress, so the deal's stage or amount can change.

watchOut: “Order Updated” also exists, so use “Order Status Paid” or one order may update the deal twice.
